MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Location Object is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Location Object is or is intended to be located.

LocationObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this Location Object.

LocationObjectTime.description: Time this Location Object was produced.

LocationObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Location Object is located.

BasicLocationCount.description: Number of Basic Locations contained in this Location Object.

BasicLocations.description: Set of Basic Locations contained in this Location Object.

BasicLocationSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic Location is located within the containing Location Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

BasicLocIDOrBasicLoc.description: Either the ID of a Basic Location or the Basic Location itself.

SubLocationCount.description: Number of child Locations contained in this Location Object.

SubLocations.description: Set of child Locations contained in this Location Object.

SubLocationSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this child Location is located within the containing Location Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

SubLocIDOrSubLoc.description: Either the ID of a child Location or the child Location itself.

LocationOrBasicLocation.description: A mixed array of Basic Locations and child Locations contained in this Location Object.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Location Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Location Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
